name: Maggie St. Pierre

moves.name: Set
moves.description: Roots in place, density up: damage taken drops 80%, enemies who melee her stagger themselves.

moves.name: Beam Walk
moves.description: A slow unstoppable advance that shoves the whole enemy front line back — territory control as a punch.

moves.name: Spotter's Call
moves.description: Taunts everything in a cone; the squad takes zero damage from taunted enemies for 4 seconds.

signature.name: Topping Out
signature.description: Maximum density, one jump, one landing. Unconditional knockdown on everything — the longest windup in the game; the squad's job is buying her the seconds. Car alarms three blocks over, filed by the gossip system under "Ballast again."

personality.summary: Unshockable; generous with time, stingy with sympathy ("you'll live"); the driest one-liners in the roster, delivered at load-bearing volume.

romance.notes: Friendship-only, and the richest arc for it. Her wife died four winters ago; the first-snow event lands on their anniversary, and her scene that night is the reason the friendship track exists.

recruitHook: Work: she won't join a squad she hasn't stood a shift with. Take three faction jobs alongside her as a non-recruit ally first; if you cut corners on any of them, the third job never comes.
differentiation: BINDING (docs/04 §1.6): Topping Out is an UNCONDITIONAL knockdown with the LONGEST windup in the game — the squad buys her the seconds.
